products.title: Authentic Madurai Kumbakonam Degree Coffee Powder (80:20 Blend)
products.description: Premium slow-roasted chicory blend ground to perfection from selected Arabica and Robusta beans of Wayanad and Coorg. Delivers rich aroma, thick decoction, and classic South Indian cafe flavor.

products.title: Tirupati Style Grand Ghee Laddu (Box of 4 Large Laddus)
products.description: Made with 100% pure cow ghee, cashew nuts, golden raisins, green cardamom, and edible camphor aroma. Hygienically packed in food-grade vacuum freshness seals for international travel.

products.title: Handcrafted Solid Brass Kamakshi Amman Deepam (6 Inch Height)
products.description: Authentic heavy-gauge brass deepam engraved with Sri Kamakshi and Gajalakshmi emblems. Traditional auspicious lamp for daily pooja, Diwali, Pongal, and housewarming ceremonies.

products.title: Authentic Chettinad Traditional Masala Combo (Pack of 4 Varieties)
products.description: Stone-ground authentic Chettinad Kulambu Milagai Thool, Pepper Chicken Chukka Masala, Biryani Spice Blend, and Rasam Podi. Free from artificial preservatives and coloring agents.

products.title: Pure Mysore Sandalwood Incense Sticks & Dhoop Cones Gift Hamper
products.description: Extracted from natural Santalum album sandalwood oil. Natural lingering aroma creating a serene, temple-like divine atmosphere in homes, prayer rooms, and meditation centers.

products.title: Authentic Kerala Kai Murukku & Kara Boondi Crispy Snack Hamper
products.description: Crispy traditional hand-twisted rice and urad flour murukku fried in pure coconut oil with asafoetida and cumin seeds. Super crunchy, nostalgic festive snack.

products.title: Cold-Pressed Wood Churned Sesame Gingelly Oil (Idhayam Style 1 Litre)
products.description: Pressed using traditional wooden chekku / ghani without heat treatment. Retains natural zinc, calcium, and sesame lignans. Essential for traditional South Indian culinary and medicinal uses.

products.title: Traditional Brass Ganesha Idol for Pooja & Car Dashboard (4 Inch)
products.description: Finely sculpted brass Vinayakar idol with antique golden finish. Brings auspicious blessings, positive vibration, and prosperity to homes and commercial spaces.

products.title: Traditional Organic Nattu Sakkarai (Pure Country Cane Sugar 1kg)
products.description: 100% natural unrefined jaggery cane sugar prepared without chemical clarifiers, sulphur, or artificial bleach. Ideal for baby foods, herbal decoctions, tea, and desserts.

products.title: Authentic Ayurvedic Chyawanprash with Amalaki & Saffron (500g)
products.description: Formulated following Charaka Samhita guidelines with 48 potent Himalayan herbs, wild amla gooseberries, raw honey, and Kashmir saffron. Elevates vigor and immunity.
